svg.title: Lyapunov exponents of two-branch flight maps and Catalan constants
svg.desc: A plot of the Lyapunov exponent of a two-branch full-Markov expanding map versus the multiplier parameter, with horizontal lines for Catalan-flavored constants showing which fall inside the achievable range and which fall outside it.
svg.text: Lyapunov spectrum of flight maps vs Catalan constants
Two-branch full Markov map on [0,1] — Lyapunov λ(m₁) plotted, Catalan-flavored constants overlaid

g.text: G itself ≈ 0.916 lies above the entire λ-range of any 2-branch full-Markov map (max λ = log 2 ≈ 0.693).
G·log 2, G/2, and log(1/G) ARE achievable as λ for specific m₁ — but the match is curve-fitting, not structural.
G is an L-value (β(2)), and L-values appear in spectral zetas of transfer operators, not as raw Lyapunovs.
